title: Range of the chart derivative lies in the tangent space (Simon 2.4.3, Part A)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and write ℝᵏ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k). Let M ⊆ ℝᴺ, V ⊆ ℝⁿ and ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ. Assume V is open, ψ is C¹ on V (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V), and ψ maps V into M (MapsTo ψ V M). Then for every x ∈ V, the range of Dψ(x) = fderiv ℝ ψ x is contained in tangentSpace M (ψ x). Here tangentSpace M y is the linear span of all vectors γ′(0) such that γ : ℝ → ℝᴺ is C¹ on (−1,1), maps (−1,1) into M, satisfies γ(0) = y and has derivative γ′(0) at 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → MapsTo ψ V M → ∀ x ∈ V, LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap ≤ tangentSpace M (ψ x)
